entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Ohap okalethtayajwo, oka Dios, Ta Am ta enekno yamlek otajwueth amej wet ochaame. Ohap okalethtayajwo hapet atana ta tek okajnayaj ih wet Am akajnayaj, hap opahtseyaj wet Am anáyatsyaj.
